description: This file contains shared utility functions, type definitions, and exports related to sending messages, media, and handling errors for Discord integration within a larger application. It includes functions for normalizing inputs, constructing message payloads, error handling, and managing Discord-specific message features.

methods.name: normalizeReactionEmoji
methods.description: Normalizes a raw emoji string into a URI-encoded identifier, handling custom emojis and standard Unicode emojis.

methods.name: normalizeStickerIds
methods.description: Validates and normalizes an array of sticker IDs, enforcing maximum count and non-empty constraints.

methods.name: normalizeEmojiName
methods.description: Trims and validates an emoji name string, ensuring it is not empty.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordPollInput
methods.description: Converts a generic poll input into a Discord-specific poll object, normalizing duration and options.

methods.name: getDiscordErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts a numeric error code from an unknown error object, handling string and number formats.

methods.name: buildDiscordSendError
methods.description: Creates a detailed DiscordSendError based on an error object and context, handling permission issues and DM failures.

methods.name: resolveChannelId
methods.description: Resolves a recipient (user or channel) into a Discord channel ID, creating a DM channel if needed.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelType
methods.description: Fetches the type of a Discord channel given its ID.

methods.name: buildDiscordTextChunks
methods.description: Splits a long text into manageable chunks respecting Discord's message size limits.

methods.name: resolveDiscordSendComponents
methods.description: Resolves components for Discord messages, supporting dynamic or static component arrays.

methods.name: resolveDiscordSendEmbeds
methods.description: Normalizes and filters embeds for Discord messages based on position (first message).

methods.name: buildDiscordMessagePayload
methods.description: Constructs a Discord message payload object from text, components, embeds, flags, and files.

methods.name: stripUndefinedFields
methods.description: Removes undefined fields from an object, returning a clean object.

methods.name: toDiscordFileBlob
methods.description: Converts Blob or Uint8Array data into a Blob suitable for Discord file uploads.

methods.name: sendDiscordText
methods.description: Sends a text message to a Discord channel, splitting into chunks if necessary.

methods.name: sendDiscordMedia
methods.description: Uploads media and sends associated text as a Discord message, handling media loading and chunking.

methods.name: buildReactionIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a string identifier for a reaction emoji, combining ID and name if available.

methods.name: formatReactionEmoji
methods.description: Formats a reaction emoji into a string identifier.
